expectations.text: For accepted, the response respects the 20-second delay and collects op-accepted, optionally with --extended, without a fresh assessment or replacing the accepted snapshot with current branch/context.
expectations.evidence: B.md:5-16 waits 20 seconds, polls op-accepted, collects --extended after completion and forbids a new submission. B.md:20-21 says the result covers the submission-time branch and context, not the current work.

expectations.text: For uncertain, the response uses the supplied --async --retry-submission recovery command and original retained request without adding new input/context options or starting a fresh review.
expectations.evidence: B.md:25-29 runs the exact supplied command 'exactly as given'. It forbids added flags, recollecting the checkout or context, and a separate submission, and says the retry sends the saved original request.

expectations.text: For storage-gap, the response distinguishes complete assessment and settled findings from failed checkpoint persistence and unverified PR handoff, does not claim the journey finished, and does not automatically buy a new full review.
expectations.evidence: B.md:38-43 answers 'no'. It distinguishes ready locally (complete coverage and findings list, no required findings open) from the failed checkpoint save and the unverified PR handoff. B.md:43 says no new review is run because of the failed save.

expectations.text: For older-result, the response refuses to certify full final coverage from missing metadata and zero findings, leaving inventory, persistence and reusable coverage unknown.
expectations.evidence: B.md:47 refuses to certify and says the missing metadata means unknown, not complete. B.md:49 says not to call the result clean or final coverage. B.md:51 leaves any new --full review to the user's decision rather than running it.

expectations.text: For entitlement, the response preserves both supplied message and hint verbatim and stops without retrying, reauthentication or a deployment/account switch.
expectations.evidence: B.md:57-58 reproduces 'Review access is not enabled for this organization.' and 'Ask your administrator to enroll the organization.' verbatim. B.md:55 stops with no retries, no other account and no other deployment.

expectations.text: For budget, the response counts two assessments rather than polls or extended collection, preserves the exhausted budget across resume, stops with F-BLOCK outstanding, and does not call the work ready.
expectations.evidence: B.md:64 counts the budget correctly and keeps it across the new session, and B.md:68 says nothing supports calling the work ready. However, B.md:72-75 does not stop with F-BLOCK outstanding. It recommends fixing F-BLOCK and handing off as 'fixed, not re-reviewed', which continues the finishing attempt even though no authorization exists.

grader_provenance.grading_scope: Anonymous paired final answers; no execution traces or earlier votes supplied.
